name: gampdf
expr: y_s = gampdf(2, 2, 1); y_v = gampdf([0 1 2 5], 2, 1); y_neg = gampdf(-1, 2, 1); y_alt1 = gampdf(0, 0.5, 1); y_aeq1 = gampdf(0, 1, 1); y_agt1 = gampdf(0, 2, 1); y_a0 = gampdf(2, 0, 1); y_aneg = gampdf(2, -1, 1); y_b0 = gampdf(2, 2, 0);
comment: Sig: y = gampdf(x, a, b). Gamma(shape=a, scale=b) PDF. Density at 0: a<1 → Inf, a=1 → 1/b, a>1 → 0. x<0 → 0. a<0 or b<=0 → NaN. a=0 → 0 (degenerate).
